in_sanskrit.name: जयन्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विजयी (vijayī) means victorious, and अंश (ansha) means part or aspect. So, Jeyansh could be interpreted as 'the victorious part' or 'the victorious aspect'.

in_hindi.name: जेयान्श
in_hindi.long_meaning: जीवन (jīvan) means life, and अंश (ansha) means part or aspect. So, Jeyansh could be interpreted as 'the part of life' or 'the aspect of life'.

in_tamil.name: ஜேயன்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜீவன் (jīvan) means life, and அஞ்சல் (añjal) means support or assistance. So, Jeyansh could be interpreted as 'the one who supports life' or 'the one who assists life'.

in_telugu.name: జైయన్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జీవన్మోదోటి (jīvanamōdōṭi) means 'that which is the life of', and అంశ (ansha) means part or aspect. So, Jeyansh could be interpreted as 'the part of the life of' or 'the aspect of the life of'.

in_marathi.name: Jeyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's, Lord's, King's
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jeyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya (Victory) + Ansh (Presence or Form). This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'God's presence' or 'Lord's form'. It is a name that carries the power and strength of the divine, and is often given to a child as a sign of hope and blessing.
